title: Indian Almond Ladoo
description: A traditional Indian sweet treat made with almonds, perfect for any occasion.
instructions: 1. In a pan, heat the ghee over medium heat.
2. Add the almonds and roast until lightly browned.
3. In a separate pan, combine the sugar, cardamom powder, and salt.
4. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves.
5. Add the roasted almonds to the sugar mixture and stir until well combined.
6. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
7. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small ladoos.
8. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
